text: {"lessons":["After several declines, I should reassess each holding against my goals and risk limits rather than let the pain of realizing a loss keep me from making a sound decision.","My sale of Stock B at a gain felt rewarding, but gains and losses relative to my purchase price should not drive trades; I should focus on each stock’s future risk and role in the portfolio.","A brief rebound after a downturn does not predict what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to short-term moves and review diversification periodically, even when I trade infrequently."]}
